primary_sources.source: Automatically Adaptive Conformal Risk Control, AISTATS 2025
primary_sources.finding: black-box risk control can adapt to input difficulty approximately conditionally

primary_sources.source: Online conformal prediction with decaying step sizes, ICML 2024
primary_sources.finding: online conformal methods can maintain retrospective sequence-level coverage and adapt in stable populations
selection + conformal risk control formalizes predict-vs-abstain with finite-sample/PAC-style guarantees

primary_sources.source: High Probability Risk Control Under Covariate Shift, PMLR 2025
primary_sources.finding: distribution shift requires explicit risk-control treatment; ordinary calibration does not automatically transfer

local_result: A 99%-confidence zero-error binomial certificate met a 0.5% target on IID calibration and IID heldout, but failed catastrophically on a constructed same-index tail shift (22/22 routed errors).
architecture_consequence: Validity certificates must carry scope and be revocable; continuous shadow reference checks and drift/hash/epoch invalidation are required.
